column15: inside the tunnel: own network a VPN, a VPN in getAllNetworks, interface tun0 fd00:1:fd00:1:fd00:1:fd00:1/128,10.1.10.1/32; left out: own network not a VPN (cellular), a VPN in getAllNetworks, interface tun0 fd00:1:fd00:1:fd00:1:fd00:1/128,10.1.10.1/32; no VPN: own network not a VPN (cellular), no VPN in getAllNetworks, no tun interface
column20: Android's references for NetworkCapabilities, ConnectivityManager and VpnService.Builder; ADR 0041
column22: Common tunnel addresses (ADR 0041, decision 3); says that every app can tell a VPN is on, and that an app left out may still find the VPN interface
